personalized_subject: Reprint alerts for Pier Six cards
personalized_email_body:
Hi Pier Six Press team,

I came across your Meow Meow Meow letterpress card and enjoyed how playful the line is. With holiday card season close, I imagine keeping popular designs in stock while planning press runs gets busy.

Shopify Automation & Integration Specialist

personalized_email_body:
Hi Rachel,

I came across the Woodcut Wovens assorted letterpress set at Heartell Press and loved that each card starts as a hand-carved woodblock. With the set offered in blue and pink and the holidays coming, the same designs probably appear in several products at once.

I help Shopify stores simplify inventory updates, order processing and supplier notifications through automation. Do your assorted sets draw from the same stock as your single cards?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Shopify Automation & Integration Specialist
